channel.title: The GW Hatchet - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The GW Hatchet (gwhatchet.com)

item.title: GW Law alum strikes deal on Shark Tank for social justice-oriented chocolate company
item.description: GW Law alum Thereasa Black appeared on Shark Tank last month, reaching a deal with two investors to financially support her date-sweetened chocolate bars after she founded the company to show her love for her daughter, providing her with a healthy sweet treat to satiate her daughter's sweet tooth.

item.title: Sports management students to attend Winter Olympic games for fan-behavior research
item.description: Lisa Neirotti, an associate professor and director of the master's in sports management program, is bringing a group of 28 students to the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games to conduct research on spectator behavior.

item.title: GW Law professors weigh constitutionality of ICE’s actions in Minnesota
item.description: GW Law professors discussed how recent immigration enforcement actions in Minnesota have raised constitutional questions about federal authority and law enforcement oversight.

item.title: SGA senators question officials on Code of Student Conduct revisions
item.description: Deputy Dean of Students Rachael Stark defended proposed Code of Student Conduct revisions to Student Government Association leaders Monday that would centralize disciplinary decisions under professional staff and eliminate student involvement in issuing sanctions.

item.title: GSEHD petition urges GW to limit downsizing, boost transparency amid restructuring
item.description: Hundreds of students, alumni, faculty and staff at the Graduate School of Education and Human Development are calling on officials to halt layoffs and boost transparency as the school undergoes what officials dubbed a "right-sizing."

item.title: GW unveils expanded draft mission statement
item.description: Chief of Staff Scott Mory and Deputy Provost for Academic Affairs Terry Murphy announced in an email to the GW community Wednesday that a draft of the University's new mission statement is now available for community feedback.

item.title: MPD charges suspect with second degree murder in fatal stabbing at Miriam’s Kitchen
item.description: Metropolitan Police Department officers responded to a report of someone fatally stabbing an adult male outside Miriam’s Kitchen Thursday night, a spokesperson confirmed.

item.title: GW Hospital diverts emergency medical care until further notice after severe flooding
item.description: Persistent cold temperatures caused several pipes at GW Hospital to burst, leading to severe flooding and cold conditions across the hospital.

item.title: Men’s basketball falls 88-86 to Duquesne, extending losing streak to four as Castro remains out
item.description: Men's basketball dropped their fourth game in a row in a close loss to Duquesne on Saturday.

item.title: Women’s basketball snaps three-game win streak with 68-58 loss to Davidson
item.description: Women’s basketball fell 68-58 to Davidson on Saturday, unable to compete with the Wildcats’ defensive pressure in the second half.
